test_columns_api_returns_expected_ids: test the columns API returns expected column IDs including id, data, and annotations fields
test_columns_api_annotates_default_colum: test the columns API annotates default columns with project_defined set to false
test_columns_api_annotates_config_define: test the columns API annotates config-defined columns with project_defined set to true
get_columns_retrieve_columns: get columns from the data manager API for a given project by posting a project and fetching /api/dm/columns
get_columns_with_label_config: get columns from the data manager API passing a label config to include project-defined columns
